item.title: Building a Home Datacenter with a Raspberry Pi Cluster - Part 1: Hardware
item.description:
Note: I’m based in Korea, so some context here is Korea-specific.

The first session is all about hardware! Let’s start with the simple stuff and quickly move on to the more complex topics.

1. SBC (Single Board Computer)

The most important thing is, of course, the SBC.

Personally, I recommend setting alerts on Danggeun Market1 and grabbing Raspberry Pi 4B 4GB or 8GB models one by one whenever they pop up.
